flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4300/ then Do these steps in order.
Click the main menu button (three lines, top left) so the menu opens.
Is this true right now: "the main menu is open and shows its items"? Store exactly yes or no as 'ready'.
Click once on an empty part of the canvas, near the bottom middle of the page, away from the menu and from any button.
Then wait 2 seconds.
Do not press Escape and do not click the menu button again.
Get whether the main menu is open and shows its items and save it as {{ready}}.
Then stop.

Waited 2 seconds; the menu was no longer open afterward.
Completed the requested interaction on the page.
